cohort: 25 women who underwent emergency hysterectomy for life-threatening postpartum hemorrhage at Shyam Shah Medical College in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh, from January 2020 to December 2020.
finding: Reduced prothrombin activity (<50%), often associated with cesarean delivery, was the most common reason for emergency hysterectomy.
mod_finding: Subtotal hysterectomy (STH) was preferred when emergency hysterectomy was necessary and was associated with less blood loss compared to total hysterectomy.
